title: All-h local obstruction to pathwise GF5 transfer
statement: For every s=2^h>=8, legal complete global typed injections f,g and an induced 18-ORIGINAL-incidence subuniverse exist with five end-clean coordinate-proper 3-edge paths sharing endpoints, ten improper physical C6 and zero original six-incidence accepted seven-GF5 positive counts on that selected subuniverse. This falsifies local pathwise positivity without further global hypotheses.

quantifiers.domain: legal complete globally injected original typed pair label maps and an induced local 18-incidence subuniverse

external_dependencies: Explicit 18-original-incidence construction and finite oracle certificate on pinned proof/code.
limitations: Does not estimate full-model S for the completed injections.
Does not refute high-minimum-degree EICE-002 transfer or Root Branch A.
Not an infinite global correlated low-S counterfamily for Branch B.
falsification_boundary: Witness applies only to a selected sparse local pattern with degree-one vertices, not arbitrary dense global graphs.
